stateAndEvents.preview: free complete choice, fresh valid input epoch; no resource or world mutation
stateAndEvents.reserve: atomic all-three cost escrow only if affordable
stateAndEvents.cancel: only before commitment, exact escrow refund once; optional receipts/rewards persist
stateAndEvents.commit: one current complete selection; irreversible worker/method/output identities
stateAndEvents.work: each selected worker has recipe-qualified departure then fresh arrival in its own work circle; recorded once; no pay-only output
stateAndEvents.generation: only selected output spawned after actual selected work; output cannot exist before authorized generation
stateAndEvents.reception: each selected output has causal departure and arrival at own court with own original recipient currently alive/present
stateAndEvents.optional: independent original identity, cost-before-reward, persistent once receipt, finite dedicated reserve; available before funding and while plan executes
stateAndEvents.final: fresh positions and life of all3 original recipients at selected courts; all selected outputs/receipts valid; loss before victory; no past-presence win
stateAndEvents.loss: required recipient anytime, selected worker before recorded work, selected result after commitment when its loss makes plan impossible; optional loss isolated
stateAndEvents.afterWorkWorker: its later loss does not undo already recorded work or require worker presence at final
stateAndEvents.saveLoad: preserve choices/escrow/commit/work/generation/arrivals/receipts/reserve/original handles and rotate input epoch; no stale queued action
stateAndEvents.terminal: main verdict closes later resource mutations; optional tasks never undo historical context
